title: Writing – Test 8
q1:
You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Read this email from your English-speaking friend Tina and the notes you have made.

From: Tina
Subject: Your flat!

Hi Sandra,

I’m so happy that you moved house. I know your previous one was very old.

How is your new flat?

Describe

Do you like the neighbourhood?

Tell Tina

Also, have you bought any new furniture?

Explain

I’d like to come and see your new house as soon as possible.

Invite Tina

See you soon,

Tina

Write your email to Tina using all the notes.
q2:
You see this notice on an English-language website.

Articles wanted!

Leisure time

What do you like doing in your free time?

Is there a new activity that you would like to try?

Write an article answering these questions and the best article will win a free month at a gym.

Write your article.
q3:
Your English teacher has asked you to write a story. Your story must begin with this sentence:

This was one of the most important days of my life.

Write your story.

notes.q1: cover all four notes: describe the new flat; tell Tina about the neighbourhood; explain what new furniture you have bought; invite Tina to visit.
notes.q2: what you like doing in your free time; a new activity you would like to try (and why).

first: This was one of the most important days of my life.
